Short title and commencement

ACT XVII OF 1991
ACT XVII OF 1991
COMPANIES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
Act further to
amend the Companies Ordinance, 1984
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th November, 1991]
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (XLVII of 1984) for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
1. Short title and
commencement.------(1) This Act may be called the Companies (Amendment)
Act, 1991.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 2, Ordinance XLVII of 1984

ACT XVII OF 1991
ACT XVII OF 1991
COMPANIES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1991
Act further to
amend the Companies Ordinance, 1984
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 27th November, 1991]
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (XLVII of 1984) for the purpose
hereinafter appearing;
2. Amendment of section 2,
Ordinance XLVII of 1984.--In the Companies Ordinance, 1984 (XLVII of 1984),
in section 2, in subsection (1), for clause (15-A) the following shall be
substituted and shall be deemed always to have been so substituted namely:--
"(15-A) "financial
institution" means an institution not less than fifty per cent of the
share capital of which is held by the Federal Government or a Provincial
Government, whether directly or through a company or corporation set up or
controlled by such Government, and includes such other institutions or
companies as the Federal Government may, by notification in the official
Gazette specify for the purpose;".
